name: Critical Alert Overlay
description: High-visibility critical alert overlay across screensaver and dashboards for peak-tariff warnings, EV charging alerts, and appliance protection.
author: mortalone

settings.title: HA Trigger Entity
settings.description: Entity ID in Home Assistant to monitor (e.g. binary_sensor.ev_uonsket_dyr_ladning_aktiv).

settings.title: Trigger State
settings.description: Entity state that triggers the alarm (default: on).

settings.title: Alert Headline
settings.description: Large bold headline displayed on screen.

settings.title: Alert Message
settings.default: Bilen eller apparater bruger strøm i spærretid! Tag stikket ud af bilen!

settings.title: Show overlay on
settings.description: Where to present the overlay (Kiosk screensavers/Fotoo, dashboards, or everywhere).

settings.title: Pulsing animation
settings.description: Pulse red glow and scale to ensure the alert cannot be missed.

settings.title: Allow snooze / dismiss
settings.description: Show a button allowing the user to temporarily snooze the overlay.

settings.title: Snooze duration
settings.description: How many minutes the overlay stays hidden after snooze.
